egin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch4:4-1↗ prop:tangent-space-submanifold Let $M \subseteq \mathbb {R}^n$ be an embedded submanifold and $Y \in \mathfrak {X}(M)$. For every point $p \in M$ and vector $v \in T_p M$, define $ abla _v^ op Y$ by (4.4).

(a) Show that $ abla _v^ op Y$ does not depend on the choice of extension $ ilde{Y}$ of $Y$. [Hint: Use Prop. A.28.]

(b) Show that $ abla _v^ op Y$ is invariant under rigid motions of $\mathbb {R}^n$, in the following sense: if $F \in E(n)$ and $ ilde{M} = F(M)$, then $dF_p( abla _v^ op Y) = abla _{dF_p(v)}^ op (F_* Y)$.

(Used on pp. 87, 93.) \end{exercise}
